ranked.headline: Transport-constrained encoders model single-cell dynamics and cross-modal expression
ranked.summary: Unpaired snapshots, perturbations, and spatial modalities now demand generative models that link latent cell states across conditions.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict drug, protein and host-pathogen interactions
ranked.summary: Graph-based deep learning now covers host-pathogen, synergy, CNS penetration and allergenicity prediction, with explainability and debiased benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Methods separate measurement noise from biology in single-cell and spatial RNA data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend imputation, denoising, deconvolution, and spatial mapping of scRNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein binding and interaction properties
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and attention architectures are now applied to binding affinity, interaction, and AlphaFold3 confidence prediction.

ranked.headline: Protein language models now drive antimicrobial discovery and sequence redesign
ranked.summary: Learned protein representations now span metagenomic-scale peptide discovery and generative redesign conditioned on structural or evolutionary context.

ranked.headline: Sampling Frames Determine Which Microbial Lineages Enter Genomic Analyses
ranked.summary: Primer design, public genome metadata, and cohort sampling each decide which pathogen and microbiome lineages current studies can capture at all.

ranked.headline: Learned representations expose neural connectivity structure across EEG, SEEG, and connectomes
ranked.summary: Latent-variable and graph models now extract disentangled connectivity and dynamics structure from EEG, SEEG, ECoG, and connectome data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict noncoding regulatory activity to prioritize variants
ranked.summary: Learned sequence and protein-language models are now feeding variant scores directly into association testing and noncoding prioritization.

ranked.headline: Quantitative models infer cell-state dynamics from single-cell and perturbation data
ranked.summary: Temporally resolved single-cell data now couple kinetic and probabilistic models to infer dynamics beyond descriptive embeddings.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links mobile elements and effectors to host and ecological context
ranked.summary: Large genome and plasmid collections now enable inventory-level inference of accessory elements tied to host association and phylogenetic context.

ranked.headline: Sequence and nucleosome context jointly govern chromatin structure and accessibility
ranked.summary: Structure-aware models now link DNA methylation and nucleosome organization to protein-DNA binding and chromatin accessibility in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: Population genomes resolve domestication history, diversity and inherited methylation
ranked.summary: Population-scale long-read and short-read resources now make diversity, domestication history and structural variation measurable across large cohorts.

ranked.headline: Inference from near-raw measurements across noise, counting, and classification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply inference directly to time series, single intensity traces, and nanopore current delays rather than to summarized features.

ranked.headline: Constraint-based and multi-omic models map disease-specific metabolic regulation
ranked.summary: Multi-omic data now support genome-scale and regulatory models of metabolic state across cancer, the gut microbiome, and Crohn's disease.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict regulatory activity and 3D chromatin from DNA sequence
ranked.summary: Pretrained DNA foundation models and Hi-C data are now being combined to predict cell type-specific expression and 3D chromatin architecture.

ranked.headline: Gapless T2T and population multiomic references anchor downstream genome analysis
ranked.summary: A gapless T2T Korean assembly and a 10,239-genome multiomic panel pair reference-grade sequence with population-scale data.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved cattle genome and tools for Y-haplogroup calling and assembly QC
ranked.summary: Reproducible genome references, haplogroup-calling workflows, and standardized assembly metrics are now packaged for direct use by researchers.

ranked.headline: GPU and SIMD acceleration of sequence alignment, motif detection, and read simulation
ranked.summary: Recent tools report genome alignment in under 6 h and up to 60x speedups for large simulated metagenomic read sets.

ranked.headline: Statistical gating and benchmarking embedded in open omics analysis tools
ranked.summary: Omics analysis tools increasingly embed statistical gating and benchmarking, yet reproducibility outcomes are not yet demonstrated in these reports.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict HIV diagnoses, protein succinylation, and RNA methylation sites
ranked.summary: Relational graphs and multi-view contrastive learning are now coupled with learned classifiers for epidemiological and sequence-level prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Learned models and benchmarks refine genomic variant calling and interpretation
ranked.summary: Long-read and hybrid pipelines are now benchmarked against T2T-Q100 truth sets as sequence models adopt diploid, zygosity-aware inputs.

ranked.headline: Membrane oscillators and ion transport emerge from local kinetic and physical rules
ranked.summary: Recent models tie membrane protein oscillations, plant cell ion balance, and protein diffusion to local rules and geometry rather than global control.

ranked.headline: Causal and enrichment criteria qualify network-derived target predictions
ranked.summary: Network-based target prioritization needs external validation, and new metrics and pipelines now test inferred regulatory and disease modules directly.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and new methods for extracting structure from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks increasingly test whether new transcriptomic and proteomic methods beat simple baselines on perturbation, single-cell, and multi-omic data.

ranked.headline: Network models of gene transfer and phylogenetic diversity in microbial sequence data
ranked.summary: Network models now extend phylogenetic diversity and gene-transfer analysis beyond single trees, alongside amplicon unit redefinition.

ranked.headline: Quantifying conformational dynamics across MD, coarse-grained and predicted ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent tools standardize flexibility and dimensionality analysis across MD, coarse-grained, and predicted conformational ensembles.

ranked.headline: Symbolic, thermodynamic and kinetic models of reaction network dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study add computational tools for bifurcation analysis, thermodynamic constraints, and kinetic fitting of reaction networks.

ranked.headline: Energetic and dynamical assessment of protein structures and binding ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply energy, Markov state, and MD-based scoring to judge structural models and ligand binding paths.

ranked.headline: Lipid transfer gating in ATG2A and pore-mediated endosomal escape of LNPs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints map lipid transfer gating in ATG2A and stalk-pore routes for LNP endosomal escape using simulation and in vitro data.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings are being packaged into prediction and design tools
ranked.summary: Recent items pair PLM embeddings with HLA-peptide prediction, binder design, and web-accessible APIs, extending their use beyond benchmark models.

ranked.headline: LLMs and networks infer disease, gene, and therapeutic relationships from data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple curated biomedical data to prediction, network inference, and explicit ranking or auditing layers.

ranked.headline: Information-theory methods and reproducible R workflows span phenotype and omics analysis
ranked.summary: Open R and Bioconductor tools now package information-theoretic and multi-omics analyses as reproducible workflows for expression and phenotype data.

ranked.headline: Open-source Python tools pair mechanistic models with ML and Bayesian calibration
ranked.summary: Recent open-source releases package mechanistic model construction, hybrid learning and calibration against heterogeneous data for reuse.

ranked.headline: New tools predict G-quadruplexes, Z-DNA and long-read transcript isoforms
ranked.summary: Structure-forming nucleic acid motifs and long-read transcript isoforms are now scored computationally at transcriptome and genome scale.

ranked.headline: Generative models now condition on explicit pocket, lead, prior, or reward information
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study couple 3D molecule generators to target structure, lead information, or reward signals within the design loop.

ranked.headline: Learning rules and circuit architectures fit to reaction-time and policy behavior
ranked.summary: Recent work fits learning rules and circuit architectures to reaction times, learning trajectories, and decision policies.

ranked.headline: Open-source LLM agents map natural-language queries onto genomic and model databases
ranked.summary: Locally deployable open-source LLMs are now wrapped in agentic workflows over curated genomic and systems biology resources.

ranked.headline: Demographic noise, dispersal, and nutrient limits reshape predator-prey cycles
ranked.summary: Stochastic noise, dispersal, and stoichiometric constraints are now modeled explicitly in predator-prey and Lotka-Volterra population dynamics.

ranked.headline: Minimizer density modeled via inverse spacing; multiminimizers approach known limit
ranked.summary: Revisits minimizer density with a probabilistic model and multiminimizers, alongside scalable index and graph construction tools.
